held_out_informal.note: private local repositories; labels kept outside this repository. Measured on 2026-10-28 with an earlier version of the rules: F1 9/11, F2 9/15, F7 15/15.

cut_rules_informal.generic account/tenant ids: mostly test data and wire-name mappings
cut_rules_informal.unrestricted boolean toggles: mostly UI properties and state assignments
cut_rules_informal.single-implementation interfaces: second implementation is usually a test fake the scanner skips

experimental.method: git-tracked non-test source read from git archive at the recorded commits (agent-rally-point limited to crates/); one sample per rule (seed 20261109-<rule>, at most 15; the refined F4 rule used seed 20261109-F4-inline-limit-v2 over hits not in the v1 sample); one rater (the author, the rules' author) labelled every sampled hit, tp meaning the value is a shared identifier or behaviour-shaping limit frozen inline with no single owner. Informal: single rater who wrote the rules, small samples, one sample dominated by private-desktop-app (most hits).
experimental.typed_constant_fix: CONST_DEF now parses typed Rust/Go/Kotlin/TS string constants and Swift `static let` (bug fix to F7, default scan). At the section F commits F7 went from 32 to 40 hits (8 new, all labelled tp); the record above was rebuilt with measure_precision.py --record and stays 14/15. On these 3 repos it adds 37 F7 hits (rally 2, private-desktop-app 35), mostly Swift/Rust cross-language env-var and file-name pairs; not separately sampled.
